GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Went Forward Settled Down Outside Leader .5 Lengths 600m 2nd .5 Lengths Straightened Up 1st Middle Of Track tired final 200m # on pace/weak late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Crowded at start and then inclined to lay in briefly. Rider reported failed to respond in straight and failed to close off after racing outside the leader.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began OK. Pushed fwd until led on rail by 1.5L early . Held lead on inside midrace & held together Two Wide (2L clear) on home turn. Pressured @ 200m & easily held margin in last 150m. # Led - too quick.
Jumped Ok Settled Down on pace 3 wide. joined leader turn 3 wide. got to front in Straight . grabbed late. 3 Wide trip # very good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide and without cover throughout the event.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well joint lead 2 Wide line of 3, ridden along turn, joint lead Straightening Up , headed approaching 100m , kept on fairly late # Eq led/headed 150m
Jumped Ok sat handy 1 length off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 1 length off, battled on strong to the line # no match 1,2
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly through the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out settled near last 6l off, swung Wide turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off all clear, found little, plodded home # weak run home
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rdr was permitted to ride 0.5kg over the allotted weight. Rdr reported his mount was inclined to lay out through the middle stages and continued to do so rounding the home turn, resulting in it making the home turn much wider than anticipated.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down 4th over/raced 4l 600m 4th fence Straightened Up 4th took inside run in Straight tired final 100m # pulled/tired late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly for some distance approaching the 600m and was restrained from heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok went back to 4th last 8len Hooked Out 500m Wide Straight finished well # Wide/good run
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: After beginning only fairly, soon after shifted out and made contact with rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok sat 3l off, improved Wide turn, took over Straightening Up half clear, headed approaching 100m, kept on ok # no match 1,2
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 1000m commenced to race keenly and had to be shifted  out to avoid the heels of another rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well to lead 1 length clear, ridden along turn, headed Straightening Up , kept on one pace # led/kept on well
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To settle further forward; settled in the lead.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fair sat 4l off, ridden along turn, Straightened Up 3-4l off, kept on one pace # back/no threat
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced keenly in the early and middle stages

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok back & Wide early, pressed on to lead 1 length clear b4 turn, held together turn, Straightened Up 2-3l clear and kept going strong to the line # just too good
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: COT: To be ridden with cover; settled in lead. Shifted in on jumping and bumped heavily. Raced fiercely in the early and middle stages. Rdr reported that, as notified to Stewards, he was instructed to ride the gelding with cover, but when it was racing keenly, wide and without cover through the early stages, he allowed it to stride forward and obtain the lead near the 600m.
